edus.text: Mr. Speaker,

edus.text: `` According to Meeting Rule 12 ( 1 ),

edus.text: and will convene directly until it is finished to be debated

addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: and decided DR 4/2023 Financial Bill 2023;

addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: DR 3/2023 Extraordinary Profit Levy ( Authorization ) Bill 2023; DR 7/2023 Mandatory Death Penalty Repelling Bill 2023; and DR 8/2023 Lifelong Penalty and Punishment Review Bill ( Federal Court Temporary Jurisdiction ) 2023 as at No. 1 to 4 in the Order of Business of the Meeting and Proposals today.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: After that, the Meeting will be adjourned until 10.00am on Tuesday, April 4, 2023. ''

addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: However, I have received many views

addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: and also complaints or concerns from the people

addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: that the explanations and comments from both the Honorable Minister of Finance and the Honorable Deputy Minister of Finance have recently not satisfied them.
edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: So allow us Mr. Speaker, for us to debate this matter today,

addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: It is possible if this motion is considered so

addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: that it can bring the interests of the public

addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: who really need the production of targeted EPF this time.
edus.speaker: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

addressees: Tuan Wan Ahmad Fayhsal bin Wan Ahmad Kamal [Machang]

edus.text: No, Point of Order 18 ( 1 ).

addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
